source_name: 71_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__071_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_068_text_description.md
text_description: A runway look centered on a crisp white, oversized shirt-blouse worn over a vivid red open-mesh lower garment. The shirt has a small stand collar with a shallow front notch, a clean center front placket with no visible buttons, and large vertical cutwork lace panels placed symmetrically down the upper chest, creating botanical, skin-revealing negative space. Its silhouette is boxy and slightly tunic-like, falling to the upper hip with a softly curved hem; the shoulders and sleeves are roomy, with voluminous sleeves pushed or rolled to around elbow length and finished in wide, stiff-looking cuffs. Below, a sheer red diamond-net skirt or trouser-like bottom sits close to the body, revealing the legs through the lattice and adding strong texture and contrast against the plain white shirt; dark lacing or tie detail appears near the left hip, with small darker accents visible through the mesh. The model carries a small pale lavender structured handbag at her side with narrow gray handles and gold-tone hardware. The styling is minimal and modern, balancing a crisp sculptural white top with a transparent, graphic red netted bottom.

Below, a sheer red diamond-net skirt or trouser-like bottom sits close to the body, revealing the legs through the lattice and adding strong texture and contrast against the plain white shirt; dark lacing or tie detail appears near the left hip, with small darker accents visible through the mesh. The model carries a small pale lavender structured handbag at her side with narrow gray handles and gold-tone hardware. The styling is minimal and modern, balancing a crisp sculptural white top with a transparent, graphic red netted bottom.
